player_0.content: I failed to visit the Home gym because I entered it from the Recreation room but immediately turned around to go east to the Media room, missing the opportunity to explore the south direction while there. I also prematurely ended the game in the Media room without checking if other unvisited rooms existed. Next time, I will prioritize exploring all available directions in the current room before moving to a new one. Specifically, when in the Home gym, I will choose "GO: south" to visit the next room instead of "GO: east". After visiting all reachable rooms, I will only use "DONE" when I am certain no new rooms remain.
